name: Dallas World Aquarium
tagline: Sloth Forest first, then South Africa black-footed penguins and American flamingos — no lemur card.

practical.best_start: Start at the top and spiral down if signed that way.

items.one_liner: Hoffman's two-toed sloth — hang and look twice. Sloth Forest also names three-toed.

items.presence_note: Official: Hoffman's two-toed sloth page + Sloth Forest three-toed. Soft Sloth.
